Subject: Re: Multiple recipients for one address!

Sebastien Roy wrote:
> Hey guys,
>
> We just move from sendmail to postfix, and seriously I prefer postfix 
> now  ;)
>
> I'm just having a problem to do something we do before.   First we use 
> virtual user on our postfix setup.  But we want to do something like 
> cabvp@domain.com go to etfz@domain.com and cfges@domain.com
>
> How I can do that using the virtual user setup we have?!


use virtual_alias_maps, with an entry like
cabvp@example.com      etfz@example.com, cfges@example.com


please don't use domain.com as an example domain. It is not.
